system.description:
When the missile hits, the talent turns it into a poisonous" snake. In addition to normal damage, the victim must make a saving throw vs. poison or die (or, at the DM's choice, take extra damage; [[/r 2d6 #Poison damage]], [[/r 2d10 #Poison damage]], or [[/r 2d20 #Poison damage]] are recommended amounts).

Fletched arrows in a quiver. Can be used with a long bow or short bow. These arrows are magical and provide a to-hit and damage bonus.

Important: These missiles do not become nonmagical once used.
